# 1. Field chronosequence and sand-matrix properties

## 1.1 Sand physicochemical properties

```{r sand-physicochemical-properties}
# Figure 1C
# 1) data input
df <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "metadata_nutrients", "SD-SI.txt"),
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                 header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
df <- df[, 1:46]
df$Group <- as.character(df$Group)


# 2) Variable lists + Category

vars_physical   <- c("D50","Silt","Sand","Gravel","Ks")
vars_biological <- c("FVC","DNA")

meta_cols <- c("SampleID","SeqID","Group","Planted_years","When_planted","Kind","Type","Soil_size_mean")
vars_all <- setdiff(colnames(df), meta_cols)
vars_chemical <- setdiff(vars_all, c(vars_physical, vars_biological))

vars <- unique(c(vars_biological, vars_physical, vars_chemical))
vars <- vars[vars %in% colnames(df)]

var_category <- tibble(
  variable = vars,
  Category = case_when(
    variable %in% vars_biological ~ "Biological",
    variable %in% vars_physical   ~ "Physical",
    TRUE                          ~ "Chemical"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels = c("Biological","Chemical","Physical")))


# 3) Long table + z-score (per variable across ALL samples)

dat_long <- df %>%
  select(Group, all_of(vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(vars), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value))) %>%
  left_join(var_category, by = "variable") %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  mutate(
    mu  = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sdv = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    z   = ifelse(is.na(sdv) | sdv == 0, NA_real_, (value - mu) / sdv)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# 4) GLM trend within SI (11–17): beta + p + adjR2 + BH
#    !!! use z for GLM (lm(z ~ Year)) to make beta comparable

si_years <- c("11","12","14","15","17")
min_total_n <- 12
min_years   <- 3

glm_res <- dat_long %>%
  filter(Group %in% si_years) %>%
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(Group)) %>%
  group_by(Category, variable) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    d <- .x %>% filter(!is.na(z), !is.na(Year))   # <-- GLM on z
    n_eff  <- nrow(d)
    n_year <- n_distinct(d$Year)
    if (n_eff < min_total_n || n_year < min_years) {
      return(tibble(n = n_eff, n_year = n_year, beta = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, adj_r2 = NA_real_))
    }
    fit <- tryCatch(lm(z ~ Year, data = d), error = function(e) NULL)  # <-- GLM on z
    if (is.null(fit)) {
      return(tibble(n = n_eff, n_year = n_year, beta = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, adj_r2 = NA_real_))
    }
    sm <- summary(fit)
    beta  <- unname(coef(fit)["Year"])
    pval  <- sm$coefficients["Year","Pr(>|t|)"]
    ar2   <- unname(sm$adj.r.squared)
    tibble(n = n_eff, n_year = n_year, beta = beta, p = pval, adj_r2 = ar2)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

glm_res <- glm_res %>%
  mutate(p_adj = NA_real_) %>%
  { idx <- which(!is.na(.$p)); .$p_adj[idx] <- p.adjust(.$p[idx], method = "BH"); . } %>%
  mutate(
    trend = case_when(
      !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05 & beta > 0 ~ "Increasing",
      !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05 & beta < 0 ~ "Decreasing",
      TRUE                                    ~ "NotSig"
    ),
    abs_beta = abs(replace_na(beta, 0))
  )


# 5) Ordering: Category then |beta| desc (NO inc/dec/ns grouping now)


trend_rank <- c("Increasing" = 1, "Decreasing" = 2, "NotSig" = 3)

order_tbl <- glm_res %>%
  mutate(trend_rank = trend_rank[trend]) %>%
  arrange(Category, trend_rank, desc(abs_beta), variable)

var_levels <- order_tbl %>% pull(variable)



# 6) Heatmap aggregation: median(z) per Group + Δ(17-SD)

group_levels <- c("SD","11","12","14","15","17")
min_n_per_group <- 3

agg <- dat_long %>%
  filter(Group %in% group_levels) %>%
  group_by(Category, variable, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_eff = sum(!is.na(z)),
    z_med = ifelse(n_eff >= min_n_per_group, median(z, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels))

agg_wide <- agg %>%
  select(Category, variable, Group, z_med) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = z_med)

agg_delta <- agg_wide %>%
  transmute(Category, variable, Group = "Δ(17-SD)", z_med = `17` - SD)

heat_df <- bind_rows(
  agg,
  agg_delta %>% mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = c(group_levels, "Δ(17-SD)")))
) %>%
  mutate(
    Group    = factor(as.character(Group), levels = c(group_levels, "Δ(17-SD)")),
    variable = factor(variable, levels = var_levels),
    Category = factor(Category, levels = c("Biological","Chemical","Physical"))
  )


# 7) Wilcoxon SD vs SI17 (star on Δ cell) + BH

min_wilcox_n_each <- 5

wilcox_res <- dat_long %>%
  filter(Group %in% c("SD","17")) %>%
  mutate(G2 = factor(Group, levels = c("SD","17"))) %>%
  group_by(Category, variable) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    d <- .x %>% filter(!is.na(value))
    n_sd <- sum(d$G2 == "SD")
    n_17 <- sum(d$G2 == "17")
    if (n_sd < min_wilcox_n_each || n_17 < min_wilcox_n_each) {
      return(tibble(n_sd = n_sd, n_17 = n_17, p = NA_real_))
    }
    wt <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(value ~ G2, data = d, exact = FALSE))
    tibble(n_sd = n_sd, n_17 = n_17, p = wt$p.value)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(p_adj = NA_real_) %>%
  { idx <- which(!is.na(.$p)); .$p_adj[idx] <- p.adjust(.$p[idx], method = "BH"); . } %>%
  mutate(star = ifelse(!is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05, "*", ""))

star_df <- wilcox_res %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = var_levels),
         Category = factor(Category, levels = c("Biological","Chemical","Physical"))) %>%
  filter(star == "*") %>%
  transmute(
    Category,
    variable,
    Group  = factor("Δ(17-SD)", levels = levels(heat_df$Group)),
    label  = star
  )


# 8) Row label coloring by GLM trend 

col_inc <- "#E3AF2E"
col_dec <- "#14A6B1"
col_ns  <- "#222222"

label_df <- glm_res %>%
  mutate(
    variable = factor(variable, levels = var_levels),
    lab_col = case_when(
      trend == "Increasing" ~ col_inc,
      trend == "Decreasing" ~ col_dec,
      TRUE                  ~ col_ns
    ),
    label = sprintf("<span style='color:%s'>%s</span>", lab_col, as.character(variable))
  ) %>%
  arrange(variable)

label_map <- setNames(label_df$label, as.character(label_df$variable))
missing_vars <- setdiff(levels(heat_df$variable), names(label_map))
if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  for (v in missing_vars) label_map[[v]] <- sprintf("<span style='color:%s'>%s</span>", col_ns, v)
}


# 9) Plot A: Heatmap

fill_pal <- colorRampPalette(c("#80cbc4", "#F3F6EC", "#ffa000"))(100)

p_heat <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = Group, y = variable, fill = z_med)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(
    data = star_df,
    aes(x = Group, y = variable, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4.2,
    vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  facet_grid(Category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) label_map[x]) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = fill_pal,
    limits = c(-3, 3),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = "Median z-score"
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.6, "lines"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_heat


# 10) Plot B: Main Fig F (GLM bubble)
#     x = beta coefficient; size = adj R^2

f_df <- glm_res %>%
  mutate(
    variable = factor(variable, levels = var_levels),
    Category = factor(Category, levels = c("Biological","Chemical","Physical")),
    trend    = factor(trend, levels = c("Increasing","Decreasing","NotSig")),
   # adj_r2   = ifelse(is.na(adj_r2) | adj_r2 < 0, NA_real_, adj_r2)
  )

p_F <- ggplot(f_df, aes(x = beta, y = variable)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey30") +
  geom_point(aes(size = adj_r2, color = trend), alpha = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_grid(Category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Increasing" = col_inc, "Decreasing" = col_dec, "NotSig" = col_ns),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(1.6, 8),
    name = expression("Adj. " * R^2)
  ) +
  labs(x = "SI trend (GLM beta coefficient)", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_F
```


## 1.2 D50 and hydraulic conductivity

```{r field-particle-size-D50-ks}
# Figure 1C
df <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "metadata_nutrients", "SD-SI.txt"),
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                 header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
df_selected <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(Group, D50, Ks) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Group %in% c("SD", "17"))

group_colors <- c(
  "SD" = "#F4A64E",
  "17" = "#526F43"
)

common_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# D50

p_d50 <- ggplot(
  field_size,
  aes(x = Group, y = D50)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Group),
    width = 0.52,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    color = "#333333",
    linewidth = 0.45,
    alpha = 0.70
  ) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(
    aes(color = Group),
    width = 0.16,
    size = 1.8,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("SD", "17")),
    method = "wilcox.test",
    method.args = list(exact = FALSE),
    label = "p.signif",
    label.y.npc = 0.93,
    size = 5,
    tip.length = 0.02,
    bracket.size = 0.45
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0.05, 0.18)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(D[50]~"("*mu*"m)")
  ) +
  common_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 0, 5)
  )


# Ks


p_Ks <- ggplot(
  field_size,
  aes(x = Group, y = Ks)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Group),
    width = 0.52,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    color = "#333333",
    linewidth = 0.45,
    alpha = 0.70
  ) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(
    aes(color = Group),
    width = 0.16,
    size = 1.8,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("SD", "17")),
    method = "wilcox.test",
    method.args = list(exact = FALSE),
    label = "p.signif",
    label.y.npc = 0.93,
    size = 5,
    tip.length = 0.02,
    bracket.size = 0.45
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0.05, 0.18)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(
      K[s]~"(m"~day^{-1}*")"
    )
  ) +
  common_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 5, 5)
  )

# Combine

field_size_figure <- p_d50 /
  p_Ks +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))

print(field_size_figure)
```

## 1.3 Mineral composition and PCA

```{r mineral-pca}
# Figure 1D
# Figure S1D–F

   # 1. Read data

    mydata <- read.delim(
      file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "XRD", "2020_field.txt"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      check.names = FALSE,
      header = TRUE,
      sep = "\t"
    )
    
    str(mydata)
    print(mydata)
    
   # 2. Basic data preparation

    
    # Ensure that the grouping variable is character
    mydata$year <- trimws(as.character(mydata$year))
    
    # Mineral variables:
    # all columns other than "year"
    mineral_cols <- setdiff(colnames(mydata), "year")
    
    # Convert mineral variables to numeric
    mydata[mineral_cols] <- lapply(
      mydata[mineral_cols],
      function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x))
    )
    
    # Check missing values
    if (anyNA(mydata[mineral_cols])) {
      stop(
        "Missing or non-numeric values were found in mineral columns. ",
        "Please check the input table."
      )
    }
    
    # Check negative values
    if (any(as.matrix(mydata[mineral_cols]) < 0)) {
      stop("Negative mineral abundance values were detected.")
    }
    
    # Add sample ID
    mydata$sample_id <- paste0("Sample_", seq_len(nrow(mydata)))
    
    # Numeric restoration age;
    # SD is deliberately coded as NA, not year 0
    mydata$restoration_age <- ifelse(
      mydata$year == "SD",
      NA_real_,
      as.numeric(mydata$year)
    )
    
    # Ordered display group
    group_levels <- c(
      "SD",
      sort(
        unique(mydata$year[mydata$year != "SD"])
      )
    )
    
    mydata$group <- factor(
      mydata$year,
      levels = group_levels
    )
    
    # Examine sums of mineral percentages
    mydata$mineral_sum <- rowSums(mydata[mineral_cols])
    
    print(
      mydata %>%
        select(sample_id, year, mineral_sum)
    )
    
    summary(mydata$mineral_sum)
    
    
 
    # 3. Closure to proportions
  
    # Even if the rows already sum to approximately 100,
    # close each sample to a constant sum of 1.
    
    mineral_matrix <- as.matrix(mydata[mineral_cols])
    
    mineral_prop <- mineral_matrix /
      rowSums(mineral_matrix)
    
    
    # 4. CLR transformation
    
    
    clr_transform <- function(x) {
      log(x) - mean(log(x))
    }
    
    mineral_clr <- t(
      apply(
        mineral_prop,
        1,
        clr_transform
      )
    )
    
    colnames(mineral_clr) <- mineral_cols
    rownames(mineral_clr) <- mydata$sample_id
    
    # Check CLR row sums; should be approximately zero
    print(rowSums(mineral_clr))
    
   
    # 5. PCA on CLR-transformed data
    
    # Do not scale again:
    # CLR values are already expressed on a common log-ratio scale.
    
    pca_fit <- prcomp(
      mineral_clr,
      center = TRUE,
      scale. = FALSE
    )
    
    pca_variance <- 100 *
      pca_fit$sdev^2 /
      sum(pca_fit$sdev^2)
    
    pc1_variance <- pca_variance[1]
    pc2_variance <- pca_variance[2]
    
    cat(
      "\nPC1 explained variance:",
      round(pc1_variance, 2),
      "%\n"
    )
    
    cat(
      "PC2 explained variance:",
      round(pc2_variance, 2),
      "%\n"
    )
    
    # PCA scores
    pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_fit$x[, 1:2])
    
    pca_scores$sample_id <- rownames(pca_scores)
    
    pca_scores <- pca_scores %>%
      left_join(
        mydata %>%
          select(
            sample_id,
            year,
            group,
            restoration_age
          ),
        by = "sample_id"
      )
    
    # PCA loadings
    pca_loadings <- as.data.frame(
      pca_fit$rotation[, 1:2]
    )
    
    pca_loadings$mineral <- rownames(pca_loadings)
    
    print(
      pca_loadings %>%
        arrange(desc(abs(PC1)))
    )
    
    
  
    # 6. Orient PC1 for interpretation
   
    # The sign of a PCA axis is mathematically arbitrary.
    # Here, PC1 is oriented so that increasing PC1 corresponds
    # to decreasing quartz contribution.
    #
    # Thus, positive PC1 generally represents a shift away from
    # quartz dominance and toward relatively greater contributions
    # from the other minerals.
    
    if ("Quartz" %in% pca_loadings$mineral) {
      
      quartz_loading <- pca_loadings$PC1[
        pca_loadings$mineral == "Quartz"
      ][1]
      
      if (quartz_loading > 0) {
        
        pca_scores$PC1 <- -pca_scores$PC1
        pca_loadings$PC1 <- -pca_loadings$PC1
        
        message(
          "PC1 direction was reversed so that higher PC1 ",
          "corresponds to lower relative quartz contribution."
        )
      }
    }
    
    
    
    # 7. Overall mineral-composition test
   
    # Euclidean distance on CLR data = Aitchison distance
    
    set.seed(123)
    
    permanova_result <- adonis2(
      mineral_clr ~ group,
      data = mydata,
      method = "euclidean",
      permutations = 9999
    )
    
    print(permanova_result)
    
    permanova_p <- permanova_result$`Pr(>F)`[1]
    permanova_r2 <- permanova_result$R2[1]
    
    
  
    # 8. Check multivariate dispersion
   
    # PERMANOVA can be influenced by unequal within-group dispersion.
    
    aitchison_distance <- dist(
      mineral_clr,
      method = "euclidean"
    )
    
    dispersion_fit <- betadisper(
      aitchison_distance,
      mydata$group
    )
    
    set.seed(123)
    
    dispersion_test <- permutest(
      dispersion_fit,
      permutations = 9999
    )
    
    print(dispersion_test)
    
    
 
    # 9. Restoration-age models
    
    # SD is excluded from these models because it is an unrestored
    # reference, not necessarily the actual year-zero state of the
    # restored sites.
    
    restored_scores <- pca_scores %>%
      filter(!is.na(restoration_age))
    
    # Linear model
    model_linear <- lm(
      PC1 ~ restoration_age,
      data = restored_scores
    )
    
    # Quadratic model
    model_quadratic <- lm(
      PC1 ~ restoration_age +
        I(restoration_age^2),
      data = restored_scores
    )
    
    summary(model_linear)
    summary(model_quadratic)
    
    anova(model_linear, model_quadratic)
    
    # Extract statistics
    linear_summary <- summary(model_linear)
    quadratic_summary <- summary(model_quadratic)
    
    linear_p <- coef(linear_summary)[
      "restoration_age",
      "Pr(>|t|)"
    ]
    
    linear_r2 <- linear_summary$adj.r.squared
    
    quadratic_p <- coef(quadratic_summary)[
      "I(restoration_age^2)",
      "Pr(>|t|)"
    ]
    
    quadratic_r2 <- quadratic_summary$adj.r.squared
    
    cat(
      "\nLinear trend P =",
      signif(linear_p, 4),
      "\n"
    )
    
    cat(
      "Linear adjusted R2 =",
      round(linear_r2, 3),
      "\n"
    )
    
    cat(
      "Quadratic term P =",
      signif(quadratic_p, 4),
      "\n"
    )
    
    cat(
      "Quadratic adjusted R2 =",
      round(quadratic_r2, 3),
      "\n"
    )
    
    
  
    # 10. Model-selection rule
   
    # Use the quadratic curve only if:
    # 1. the quadratic term is significant at P < 0.05, and
    # 2. adjusted R2 is improved relative to the linear model.
    #
    # Otherwise use the simpler linear trend.
    
    use_quadratic <- (
      !is.na(quadratic_p) &&
        quadratic_p < 0.05 &&
        quadratic_r2 > linear_r2
    )
    
    if (use_quadratic) {
      
      selected_model <- model_quadratic
      selected_model_name <- "Quadratic"
      
      trend_label <- paste0(
        "Restoration-age pattern: quadratic\n",
        "P", "\u209B\u2092", "\u00B2", " = ",
        format.pval(
          quadratic_p,
          digits = 2,
          eps = 0.001
        ),
        ", adj. R\u00B2 = ",
        sprintf("%.2f", quadratic_r2)
      )
      
    } else {
      
      selected_model <- model_linear
      selected_model_name <- "Linear"
      
      trend_label <- paste0(
        "Restoration-age trend: linear\n",
        "P = ",
        format.pval(
          linear_p,
          digits = 2,
          eps = 0.001
        ),
        ", adj. R\u00B2 = ",
        sprintf("%.2f", linear_r2)
      )
    }
    
    cat(
      "\nSelected display model:",
      selected_model_name,
      "\n"
    )
    
   
    # 11. Prediction data
   
    prediction_data <- data.frame(
      restoration_age = seq(
        min(restored_scores$restoration_age),
        max(restored_scores$restoration_age),
        length.out = 300
      )
    )
    
    prediction_values <- predict(
      selected_model,
      newdata = prediction_data,
      interval = "confidence",
      level = 0.95
    )
    
    prediction_data <- cbind(
      prediction_data,
      as.data.frame(prediction_values)
    )
    
    
    
    # 12. Group summaries
   
    pc1_summary <- pca_scores %>%
      group_by(group, year, restoration_age) %>%
      summarise(
        n = n(),
        mean_PC1 = mean(PC1),
        sd_PC1 = sd(PC1),
        se_PC1 = sd_PC1 / sqrt(n),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    print(pc1_summary)
    
    

    # 13. Plotting x coordinates
    
    # Put SD to the left with a clear visual gap.
    # SD is not treated as restoration year zero.
    
    minimum_restored_age <- min(
      restored_scores$restoration_age
    )
    
    sd_x_position <- minimum_restored_age - 2.2
    
    pca_scores$plot_x <- ifelse(
      pca_scores$year == "SD",
      sd_x_position,
      pca_scores$restoration_age
    )
    
    pc1_summary$plot_x <- ifelse(
      pc1_summary$year == "SD",
      sd_x_position,
      pc1_summary$restoration_age
    )
    
    
    
    # 14. Colours
    
    age_colours <- c(
      "SD" = "#E69F00",
      "11" = "#D9E878",
      "12" = "#B7CC63",
      "14" = "#8DAA55",
      "15" = "#718C47",
      "17" = "#4F6F3B"
    )
    
  
    # 15. Statistical annotation

    overall_label <- paste0(
      "Overall composition: ",
      "PERMANOVA ",
      "P",
      " = ",
      format.pval(
        permanova_p,
        digits = 2,
        eps = 0.001
      ),
      ", R\u00B2 = ",
      sprintf("%.2f", permanova_r2)
    )
    
    # Because plotmath and ordinary strings are awkward to combine,
    # use a clean plain-text label in the plot.
    overall_label_plain <- paste0(
      "Overall composition: PERMANOVA P ",
      ifelse(permanova_p < 0.001, "< 0.001", paste0("= ", signif(permanova_p, 2))),
      ", R\u00B2 = ",
      sprintf("%.2f", permanova_r2)
    )
    
    
    # 16. Main one-panel figure

    set.seed(123)
    
    
    
    pc1_y_min <- min(
      c(
        pca_scores$PC1,
        prediction_data$lwr
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
    pc1_y_max <- max(
      c(
        pca_scores$PC1,
        prediction_data$upr
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
    pc1_y_range <- pc1_y_max - pc1_y_min
    
    # Add space for annotations
    plot_y_min <- pc1_y_min - 0.12 * pc1_y_range
    plot_y_max <- pc1_y_max + 0.23 * pc1_y_range
    
    
    set.seed(123)
    
    main_plot <- ggplot() +
      
      # Confidence interval for restoration-age model
      geom_ribbon(
        data = prediction_data,
        aes(
          x = restoration_age,
          ymin = lwr,
          ymax = upr
        ),
        fill = "#718C47",
        alpha = 0.15
      ) +
      
      # Linear fitted trajectory
      geom_line(
        data = prediction_data,
        aes(
          x = restoration_age,
          y = fit
        ),
        colour = "#3F5633",
        linewidth = 1.05
      ) +
      
      # Individual samples
      geom_point(
        data = pca_scores,
        aes(
          x = plot_x,
          y = PC1,
          fill = group
        ),
        shape = 21,
        size = 3.2,
        stroke = 0.55,
        colour = "black",
        alpha = 0.85,
        position = position_jitter(
          width = 0.08,
          height = 0,
          seed = 123
        )
      ) +
      
      # Mean ± SE
      geom_errorbar(
        data = pc1_summary,
        aes(
          x = plot_x,
          ymin = mean_PC1 - se_PC1,
          ymax = mean_PC1 + se_PC1
        ),
        width = 0.14,
        linewidth = 0.65,
        colour = "black"
      ) +
      
      # Group means
      geom_point(
        data = pc1_summary,
        aes(
          x = plot_x,
          y = mean_PC1
        ),
        shape = 23,
        size = 3.2,
        stroke = 0.75,
        fill = "white",
        colour = "black"
      ) +
      
      # Separate SD from the restored chronosequence
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = minimum_restored_age - 1.1,
        linetype = "dotted",
        linewidth = 0.55,
        colour = "grey55"
      ) +
      
      # Restoration-region label
      # annotate(
      #   "text",
      #   x = mean(range(restored_scores$restoration_age)),
      #   y = plot_y_max,
      #   label = "Restoration chronosequence",
      #   vjust = 1.15,
      #   size = 3.45,
      #   colour = "grey20"
      # ) +
      # 
      # Statistical annotation
      # annotate(
      #   "text",
      #   x = 11.05,
      #   y = plot_y_max - 0.055 * pc1_y_range,
      #   label = paste0(
      #     "PERMANOVA: P < 0.001, R\u00B2 = 0.60\n",
      #     "Age trend: P = 0.022, adj. R\u00B2 = 0.29"
      #   ),
      #   hjust = 0,
      #   vjust = 1,
      #   size = 3.15,
      #   lineheight = 1.15,
      #   colour = "black"
      # ) +
      
      # Positive-PC1 interpretation
      # annotate(
      #   "text",
      #   x = Inf,
      #   y = pc1_y_max,
      #   label = "Greater relative\nmicrocline contribution",
      #   hjust = 1.04,
      #   vjust = 1.05,
      #   size = 2.9,
      #   lineheight = 0.95,
      #   colour = "#3F5633"
      # ) +
      
      # Negative-PC1 interpretation
      # annotate(
      #   "text",
      #   x = Inf,
      #   y = pc1_y_min,
      #   # label = paste0(
      #   #   "Greater relative quartz, albite,\n",
      #   #   "and muscovite contributions"
      #   # ),
      #   hjust = 1.04,
      #   vjust = -0.10,
      #   size = 2.9,
      #   lineheight = 0.95,
      #   colour = "grey35"
      # ) +
      
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = age_colours,
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      
      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = c(
          sd_x_position,
          sort(unique(restored_scores$restoration_age))
        ),
        labels = c(
          "SD",
          sort(unique(restored_scores$restoration_age))
        ),
        expand = expansion(
          mult = c(0.07, 0.08)
        )
      ) +
      
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(
          plot_y_min,
          plot_y_max
        ),
        expand = expansion(
          mult = c(0, 0)
        )
      ) +
      
      labs(
        x = "Restoration age (years)",
        y = paste0(
          "Mineral composition PC1 (",
          sprintf("%.1f", pc1_variance),
          "% variance)"
        )
      ) +
      
      theme_classic(
        base_size = 16
      ) +
      
      theme(
        axis.title = element_text(
          colour = "black",
          size = 16
        ),
        axis.text = element_text(
          colour = "black",
          size = 16
        ),
        axis.line = element_line(
          colour = "black",
          linewidth = 0.55
        ),
        axis.ticks = element_line(
          colour = "black",
          linewidth = 0.55
        ),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.margin = margin(
          t = 5,
          r = 6,
          b = 5,
          l = 5
        )
      )
    
    print(main_plot)
    

    # figure s1D-F for XRD mineral composition
    #
    # A. CLR-PCA ordination, labeled as S1D
    # B. PC1 mineral loadings, labeled as S1E
    # C. Original mineral proportions across restoration stages, labeled as S1F
    # This code continues from the previous main-figure script.
    
    # 1. Prepare CLR data in long format

    
    clr_data <- as.data.frame(mineral_clr)
    
    clr_data$sample_id <- rownames(clr_data)
    
    clr_data <- clr_data %>%
      left_join(
        mydata %>%
          select(
            sample_id,
            year,
            group,
            restoration_age
          ),
        by = "sample_id"
      )
    
    clr_long <- clr_data %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = all_of(mineral_cols),
        names_to = "mineral",
        values_to = "clr_value"
      )
    
    clr_long$mineral <- factor(
      clr_long$mineral,
      levels = mineral_cols
    )
    
    
  
    # 2. Statistical analysis of individual minerals

    
    # For each mineral:
    # 1. overall difference among SD and all restored stages;
    # 2. linear restoration-age trend using only 11–17-year sites;
    # 3. BH correction across the five minerals.
    
    mineral_statistics <- clr_long %>%
      group_by(mineral) %>%
      group_modify(
        ~{
          
          mineral_all <- .x
          
          mineral_restored <- .x %>%
            filter(!is.na(restoration_age))
          
          # Overall group model
          overall_model <- lm(
            clr_value ~ group,
            data = mineral_all
          )
          
          overall_anova <- anova(overall_model)
          
          overall_p <- overall_anova[
            "group",
            "Pr(>F)"
          ]
          
          # Linear restoration-age model
          age_model <- lm(
            clr_value ~ restoration_age,
            data = mineral_restored
          )
          
          age_model_summary <- summary(age_model)
          
          age_p <- coef(age_model_summary)[
            "restoration_age",
            "Pr(>|t|)"
          ]
          
          age_beta <- coef(age_model_summary)[
            "restoration_age",
            "Estimate"
          ]
          
          age_adj_r2 <- age_model_summary$adj.r.squared
          
          # Quadratic model, reported for checking only
          quadratic_model <- lm(
            clr_value ~ restoration_age +
              I(restoration_age^2),
            data = mineral_restored
          )
          
          quadratic_summary <- summary(quadratic_model)
          
          quadratic_p <- coef(quadratic_summary)[
            "I(restoration_age^2)",
            "Pr(>|t|)"
          ]
          
          quadratic_adj_r2 <- quadratic_summary$adj.r.squared
          
          tibble(
            overall_p = overall_p,
            age_beta = age_beta,
            age_p = age_p,
            age_adj_r2 = age_adj_r2,
            quadratic_p = quadratic_p,
            quadratic_adj_r2 = quadratic_adj_r2
          )
        }
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(
        overall_q = p.adjust(
          overall_p,
          method = "BH"
        ),
        age_q = p.adjust(
          age_p,
          method = "BH"
        ),
        quadratic_q = p.adjust(
          quadratic_p,
          method = "BH"
        ),
        trend_direction = case_when(
          age_beta > 0 ~ "Positive",
          age_beta < 0 ~ "Negative",
          TRUE ~ "None"
        )
      )
    
    print(mineral_statistics)
    
    
    # Save statistics
    write.table(
      mineral_statistics,
      file = file.path(
        output_directory,
        "XRD_individual_mineral_statistics.tsv"
      ),
      sep = "\t",
      quote = FALSE,
      row.names = FALSE
    )
    
    
    
    # 3. Panel A: CLR-PCA ordination
 
    # Group centroids
    pca_centroids <- pca_scores %>%
      group_by(
        group,
        year,
        restoration_age
      ) %>%
      summarise(
        PC1 = mean(PC1),
        PC2 = mean(PC2),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    # Temporal trajectory for restored sites only
    restored_centroids <- pca_centroids %>%
      filter(year != "SD") %>%
      arrange(restoration_age)
    
    
    panel_A <- ggplot(
      pca_scores,
      aes(
        x = PC1,
        y = PC2
      )
    ) +
      
      # Connect restored centroids chronologically
      geom_path(
        data = restored_centroids,
        aes(
          x = PC1,
          y = PC2,
          group = 1
        ),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        colour = "grey35",
        linewidth = 0.7,
        arrow = arrow(
          length = unit(0.12, "cm"),
          type = "closed"
        )
      ) +
      
      # Individual samples
      geom_point(
        aes(
          fill = group
        ),
        shape = 21,
        size = 3.1,
        stroke = 0.55,
        colour = "black",
        alpha = 0.85
      ) +
      
      # Group centroids
      geom_point(
        data = pca_centroids,
        aes(
          x = PC1,
          y = PC2
        ),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        shape = 23,
        size = 3.4,
        stroke = 0.75,
        fill = "white",
        colour = "black"
      ) +
      
      # Group labels
      geom_text_repel(
        data = pca_centroids,
        aes(
          x = PC1,
          y = PC2,
          label = year
        ),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 6.1,
        colour = "black",
        min.segment.length = 0,
        box.padding = 0.25,
        point.padding = 0.25,
        seed = 123,
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      
     # Statistical result
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = Inf,
        y = -Inf,
        label = paste0(
          "PERMANOVA: P < 0.001, R\u00B2 = 0.60\n",
          "Dispersion: P = 0.293"
        ),
        hjust = 1.03,
        vjust = -0.35,
        size = 3.0,
        lineheight = 1.1
      ) +
      
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = age_colours,
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      
      labs(
        x = paste0(
          "PC1 (",
          sprintf("%.1f", pc1_variance),
          "%)"
        ),
        y = paste0(
          "PC2 (",
          sprintf("%.1f", pc2_variance),
          "%)"
        )
      ) +
      
      coord_equal(
        clip = "off"
      ) +
      
      theme_classic(
        base_size = 16
      ) +
      
      theme(
        axis.title = element_text(
          size = 16,
          colour = "black"
        ),
        axis.text = element_text(
          size = 16,
          colour = "black"
        ),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.margin = margin(
          t = 10,
          r = 12,
          b = 10,
          l = 10
        )
      )
    panel_A
    
    
   
    # 4. Panel B: PC1 loadings
  
    
    loading_plot_data <- pca_loadings %>%
      select(
        mineral,
        PC1
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        mineral = factor(
          mineral,
          levels = mineral[
            order(PC1)
          ]
        ),
        loading_direction = ifelse(
          PC1 >= 0,
          "Positive",
          "Negative"
        ),
        loading_label = sprintf(
          "%+.2f",
          PC1
        )
      )
    
    
    panel_B <- ggplot(
      loading_plot_data,
      aes(
        x = PC1,
        y = mineral,
        fill = loading_direction
      )
    ) +
      
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = 0,
        linewidth = 0.55,
        colour = "black"
      ) +
      
      geom_col(
        width = 0.66,
        colour = "black",
        linewidth = 0.35
      ) +
      
      geom_text(
        aes(
          label = loading_label,
          hjust = ifelse(
            PC1 >= 0,
            -0.12,
            1.12
          )
        ),
        size = 4.5,
        colour = "black"
      ) +
      
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c(
          "Positive" = "#718C47",
          "Negative" = "#B7B7B7"
        )
      ) +
      
      scale_x_continuous(
        limits = c(
          min(loading_plot_data$PC1) - 0.15,
          max(loading_plot_data$PC1) + 0.15
        ),
        breaks = seq(
          -0.6,
          0.8,
          by = 0.2
        ),
        expand = expansion(
          mult = c(0, 0)
        )
      ) +
      
      labs(
        x = "PC1 loading",
        y = NULL
      ) +
      
      theme_classic(
        base_size = 16
      ) +
      
      theme(
        axis.title = element_text(
          size = 16,
          colour = "black"
        ),
        axis.text.x = element_text(
          size = 16,
          colour = "black", angle = 25, hjust = 0.8,vjust = 0.8
        ),
        axis.text.y = element_text(
          size = 16,
          colour = "black"
        ),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.margin = margin(
          t = 7,
          r = 22,
          b = 8,
          l = 7
        )
      )
    panel_B
    
    
  
    # Panel C: Original mineral proportions
    #
    # Statistics:
    # 1. Kruskal–Wallis:
    #    SD + all restored stages as categorical groups
    #
    # 2. Linear regression:
    #    restoration age as a continuous variable;
    #    restored sites only (11–17 years)
    #
    # 3. BH correction:
    #    separately across the five minerals
    #
    # Plot:
    # - original mineral percentages
    # - individual samples
    # - mean ± SE
    # - linear trend and 95% confidence interval
 

   
    # 1. Basic variables
    
    # All mineral columns
    mineral_cols <- setdiff(
      colnames(mydata),
      c(
        "year",
        "sample_id",
        "restoration_age",
        "group",
        "mineral_sum"
      )
    )
    
    # Keep only numeric mineral columns
    mineral_cols <- mineral_cols[
      vapply(
        mydata[mineral_cols],
        is.numeric,
        logical(1)
      )
    ]
    
    print(mineral_cols)
    
    
    # Ensure year is character
    mydata$year <- trimws(
      as.character(mydata$year)
    )
    
    # Sample ID
    if (!"sample_id" %in% colnames(mydata)) {
      mydata$sample_id <- paste0(
        "Sample_",
        seq_len(nrow(mydata))
      )
    }
    
    # Restoration age:
    # SD is not coded as year zero
    mydata$restoration_age <- ifelse(
      mydata$year == "SD",
      NA_real_,
      as.numeric(mydata$year)
    )
    
    # Ordered group
    group_levels <- c(
      "SD",
      as.character(
        sort(
          unique(
            mydata$restoration_age[
              !is.na(mydata$restoration_age)
            ]
          )
        )
      )
    )
    
    mydata$group <- factor(
      mydata$year,
      levels = group_levels
    )
    
    
   
    # 2. Convert to long format
   
    
    mineral_raw_long <- mydata %>%
      select(
        sample_id,
        year,
        group,
        restoration_age,
        all_of(mineral_cols)
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = all_of(mineral_cols),
        names_to = "mineral",
        values_to = "percentage"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        mineral = factor(
          mineral,
          levels = mineral_cols
        )
      )
    
    print(mineral_raw_long)
    
    
  
    # 3. Plotting positions

    
    minimum_restored_age <- min(
      mineral_raw_long$restoration_age,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
    sd_x_position <- minimum_restored_age - 2.2
    
    divider_x_position <- minimum_restored_age - 1.1
    
    mineral_raw_long <- mineral_raw_long %>%
      mutate(
        plot_x = ifelse(
          year == "SD",
          sd_x_position,
          restoration_age
        )
      )
    
    

    # 4. Group summary:
    # mean ± SE
 
    
    mineral_raw_summary <- mineral_raw_long %>%
      group_by(
        mineral,
        group,
        year,
        restoration_age,
        plot_x
      ) %>%
      summarise(
        n = sum(!is.na(percentage)),
        mean_percentage = mean(
          percentage,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        sd_percentage = sd(
          percentage,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        se_percentage = sd_percentage / sqrt(n),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    print(mineral_raw_summary)
    
    
 
    # 5. Statistics
   
    # KW:
    #   all six stages
    #
    # Linear regression:
    #   restored sites only
    #
    # Both use original percentages.
    
    mineral_statistics <- mineral_raw_long %>%
      group_by(mineral) %>%
      group_modify(
        ~{
          
          current_all <- .x %>%
            filter(
              !is.na(percentage),
              !is.na(group)
            )
          
          current_restored <- .x %>%
            filter(
              !is.na(percentage),
              !is.na(restoration_age)
            )
          
          # Kruskal–Wallis test
          kw_result <- kruskal.test(
            percentage ~ group,
            data = current_all
          )
          
          # Linear regression
          linear_model <- lm(
            percentage ~ restoration_age,
            data = current_restored
          )
          
          linear_summary <- summary(
            linear_model
          )
          
          linear_beta <- coef(
            linear_summary
          )[
            "restoration_age",
            "Estimate"
          ]
          
          linear_p <- coef(
            linear_summary
          )[
            "restoration_age",
            "Pr(>|t|)"
          ]
          
          linear_adj_r2 <- linear_summary$adj.r.squared
          
          tibble(
            kw_p = kw_result$p.value,
            linear_beta = linear_beta,
            linear_p = linear_p,
            linear_adj_r2 = linear_adj_r2
          )
        }
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(
        # BH adjustment across five minerals
        kw_q = p.adjust(
          kw_p,
          method = "BH"
        ),
        linear_q = p.adjust(
          linear_p,
          method = "BH"
        ),
        trend_direction = case_when(
          linear_beta > 0 ~ "Positive",
          linear_beta < 0 ~ "Negative",
          TRUE ~ "None"
        )
      )
    
    print(mineral_statistics)
    
 
    
  
    # 6. Statistical labels
 
    
    format_q_value <- function(x) {
      
      ifelse(
        x < 0.001,
        "q < 0.001",
        paste0(
          "q = ",
          sprintf("%.3f", x)
        )
      )
    }
    
    mineral_stat_labels <- mineral_statistics %>%
      mutate(
        label = paste0(
          "Kruskal\u2013Wallis: ",
          format_q_value(kw_q),
          "\n",
          "Linear regression: ",
          format_q_value(linear_q)
        )
      )
    
    print(mineral_stat_labels)
    
    
    
    # 7. Colours
   
    
    age_colours <- c(
      "SD" = "#E69F00",
      "11" = "#DDE879",
      "12" = "#BCCF67",
      "14" = "#91AA58",
      "15" = "#718C47",
      "17" = "#4F6F3B"
    )
    
    
  
    # 8. Panel C

    set.seed(123)
    
    
    mineral_order <- c(
      "Microcline",
      "Clinochlore",
      "Quartz",
      "Albite",
      "Muscovite"
    )
    
    mineral_raw_long$mineral <- factor(
      mineral_raw_long$mineral,
      levels = mineral_order
    )
    
    mineral_raw_summary$mineral <- factor(
      mineral_raw_summary$mineral,
      levels = mineral_order
    )
    
    mineral_stat_labels$mineral <- factor(
      mineral_stat_labels$mineral,
      levels = mineral_order
    )
    
    
    panel_C <- ggplot() +
      
      # Linear regression and 95% CI:
      # restored sites only
      geom_smooth(
        data = mineral_raw_long %>%
          filter(
            !is.na(restoration_age)
          ),
        aes(
          x = restoration_age,
          y = percentage
        ),
        method = "lm",
        formula = y ~ x,
        se = TRUE,
        level = 0.95,
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        colour = "#3F5633",
        fill = "#718C47",
        linewidth = 0.8,
        alpha = 0.15
      ) +
      
      # Individual samples
      geom_point(
        data = mineral_raw_long,
        aes(
          x = plot_x,
          y = percentage,
          fill = group
        ),
        shape = 21,
        size = 2.3,
        stroke = 0.4,
        colour = "black",
        alpha = 0.82,
        position = position_jitter(
          width = 0.07,
          height = 0,
          seed = 123
        )
      ) +
      
      # Mean ± SE
      geom_errorbar(
        data = mineral_raw_summary,
        aes(
          x = plot_x,
          ymin = mean_percentage - se_percentage,
          ymax = mean_percentage + se_percentage
        ),
        width = 0.12,
        linewidth = 0.52,
        colour = "black"
      ) +
      
      # Group means
      geom_point(
        data = mineral_raw_summary,
        aes(
          x = plot_x,
          y = mean_percentage
        ),
        shape = 23,
        size = 2.5,
        stroke = 0.65,
        fill = "white",
        colour = "black"
      ) +
      
      # Separate SD from restoration chronosequence
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = divider_x_position,
        linetype = "dotted",
        linewidth = 0.45,
        colour = "grey55"
      ) +
      
     # Statistical results
      geom_text(
        data = mineral_stat_labels,
        aes(
          x = Inf,
          y = Inf,
          label = label
        ),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        hjust = 1.03,
        vjust = 1.15,
        size = 2.6,
        lineheight = 1.05,
        colour = "black"
      ) +
      
      # One panel for each original mineral
      facet_wrap(
        ~mineral,
        nrow = 1,
        scales = "free_y"
      ) +
      
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = age_colours,
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      
      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = c(
          sd_x_position,
          sort(
            unique(
              mineral_raw_long$restoration_age[
                !is.na(
                  mineral_raw_long$restoration_age
                )
              ]
            )
          )
        ),
        labels = c(
          "SD",
          sort(
            unique(
              mineral_raw_long$restoration_age[
                !is.na(
                  mineral_raw_long$restoration_age
                )
              ]
            )
          )
        ),
        expand = expansion(
          mult = c(0.08, 0.08)
        )
      ) +
      
      # Additional upper space for statistical annotations
      scale_y_continuous(
        expand = expansion(
          mult = c(0.10, 0.28)
        )
      ) +
      
      labs(
        x = "Restoration age (years)",
        y = "Mineral proportion (%)"
      ) +
      
      theme_classic(
        base_size = 9.5
      ) +
      
      theme(
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        
        strip.text = element_text(
          size = 16,
          face = "plain",
          colour = "black",
          margin = margin(
            b = 4
          )
        ),
        
        axis.title = element_text(
          size = 16,
          colour = "black"
        ),
        
        axis.text = element_text(
          size = 16,
          colour = "black"
        ),
        
        axis.text.x = element_text(
          angle = 0,
          hjust = 0.5,
          vjust = 0.5
        ),
        
        axis.line = element_line(
          colour = "black",
          linewidth = 0.5
        ),
        
        axis.ticks = element_line(
          colour = "black",
          linewidth = 0.45
        ),
        
        panel.spacing.x = unit(
          0.55,
          "lines"
        ),
        
        legend.position = "none",
        
        plot.margin = margin(
          t = 7,
          r = 8,
          b = 6,
          l = 7
        )
      )
    
    print(panel_C)
```
